title: Rules
description: The root of `rules.json`: how the game works for this career, level tables that values in game-state.json refer to.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written, in ISO 8601 with the local time's UTC offset.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

moraleLevels.description: The morale levels, which game-state.json company.morale.level refers to.

reputationLevels.description: The reputation levels, which game-state.json company.reputation.*.level refers to.

mercenaryReviewBoardLevels.description: The Mercenary Review Board rating levels, which game-state.json company.mercenaryReviewBoard.level refers to.

skills.description: The training table behind every pilot's skill levels and abilities, in the barracks and the hiring hall (game-state.json pilots[].skills and game-state.json hiringHall[].skills).

spiritsLevels.description: The effects of each spirits level, which game-state.json pilots[].spirits.level refers to.

mechPartsPerMech.description: How many parts of a mech, game-state.json storage.mechParts[].count, assemble it.

contractTypes.description: The mission types, referred to by game-state.json activeContract.type, mission-outcome.json contract.type and game-state.json contracts[].type.

jumpDistances.description: The jump distance by number of working jump jets, from one up; the last entry applies to any higher number.

combat.description: The combat rules behind to-hit, heat, stability, hit locations, visibility and resolve.

campaign.description: The campaign rules behind the mech lab, med bay, hiring, salvage, finances, contracts and travel.

ExportTrigger.description: What caused an export. `careerLoaded`: A career is loaded, new or from a save. The game state is skipped while a finished contract's results are still to be applied, and the catalog is rebuilt only when it's missing or stale, once the game has loaded every vehicle, turret and design mask. `manualSave`: The player saves the career outside combat. `autosave`: The game saves the career on its own outside combat, e.g. once an event's popup is closed with the picked option's results applied, or once a contract's results are applied. `contractCompleted`: A contract's results are applied, salvage included, where the game doesn't save the career afterwards, which is `autosave` otherwise. `financialReportShown`: The monthly financial report is shown, with the expenses paid. `mechLabOrderCompleted`: A mech lab order completes, at the end of a day or right away when it has nothing left to do; when several work orders complete together, the last one names the export. `pilotHealed`: A pilot's healing in the med bay completes, as `mechLabOrderCompleted`. `shipUpgradeCompleted`: An Argo upgrade's installation completes, as `mechLabOrderCompleted`. `contractsGenerated`: The game has generated a star system's contracts. `jumped`: The ship has jumped into its destination star system, at the end of that day, with the star system's contracts; work orders completing that day export with it. `arrived`: The ship arrives at the planet after a trip. `storeClosed`: A store closes, from the main screen or the mech lab. `purchaseCompleted`: The store screen completes a purchase, or refuses one. `saleCompleted`: The store screen completes a sale, or refuses one, once for a stack sold at once. `mechBayChanged`: The mech bay changes: a refit, repair, readying or storing is queued, an order is cancelled, the work queue is reordered, a mech or chassis is stored or scrapped, a stored component's repair is queued, or a mech is renamed without a refit. `experienceSpent`: The barracks confirm a pilot's training. `mechPlacementShown`: The game asks where to put a new mech because every mech bay is full, e.g. after salvage completes one. `missionCompleted`: A mission ends, still in combat, before the salvage is chosen. `salvageChosen`: The after-action report has finalized the salvage: once the priority salvage is confirmed, or right away when there is nothing to choose. `shipUpgradeStarted`: An Argo upgrade is bought and its installation starts. `phaseStarted`: A phase begins, before its first unit acts: the battle's first once the lance is deployed, and every later one, also one reached by reserving units. `combatStarted`: A new battle begins, when the briefing is dismissed. `combatLoaded`: A battle is loaded from a save, continuing mid-phase. `activationCompleted`: A unit's activation is done, its attacks resolved; out of contact, once the player's units have all moved. Reserving a unit doesn't count.

MoraleLevel.description: A level of the company's morale, and what it does in combat.

level.description: The level's name as the UI shows it, which game-state.json company.morale.level refers to.

startsAt.description: The lowest company morale in the level.

resolvePerRound.description: The morale level's share of the resolve gained per combat round; the lance's own bonuses add to it.

ReputationLevel.description: A faction reputation level and its effects.

level.description: The level as the game names it, e.g. `LIKED`.

startsAt.description: The lowest reputation value in the level.

maxContractDifficulty.description: The highest difficulty of the faction's contracts offered at this level, including the career's current global difficulty. Story, restoration and flashpoint contracts aren't limited.

canUseSystemStore.description: Whether the system store is open at this level with the star system's owner.

storePriceChangePercent.description: The change of store prices at this level with the store's faction (the star system's owner, or the pirates at the black market), as a percentage of an item's cost added to its price, as the UI shows it. It adds to the star system's own discount.

SimGameReputation.description: A reputation level, described in rules.json reputationLevels.

MercenaryReviewBoardLevel.description: A level of the Mercenary Review Board rating, and what it allows.

level.description: The rating level, from 0, which game-state.json company.mercenaryReviewBoard.level refers to.

startsAt.description: The lowest rating value in the level.

maxHireableSkillTotal.description: The highest skill total of a pilot the company can hire at this level.

contractReputationMultiplier.description: Multiplies a contract's difficulty into the rating gained from it.

SkillRules.description: The training table of each pilot skill and the limits on choosing primary abilities.

maxPrimaryAbilities.description: How many primary abilities a pilot can hold in total.

maxPrimaryAbilitiesPerSkill.description: How many of them can come from one skill.

description.description: What the skill controls, as the barracks explains it.

levels.description: The levels a pilot can train to; every pilot starts at level 1.

GunneryLevel.description: A level of the Gunnery skill.

experienceCost.description: The experience spent to reach the level from the one below.

abilities.description: The primary abilities and passive traits unlocked at the level.

baseHitChancePercent.description: The hit chance of ranged attacks at this level, before the attack's modifiers.

SkillLevelAbility.description: An ability a skill level unlocks.

ability.description: The ability, by its definition's id and name.

isPrimary.description: A primary ability is chosen, a passive trait comes with the level.

description.description: The game's description of the ability, as plain text.

activationTiming.description: The game's activation timing of the ability, e.g. `Passive`, `ConsumedByFiring` or `CommandAbility`.

targeting.description: How the ability is aimed; `null` when it isn't.

cooldown.description: The unit's activations before the ability can be used again; `null` when it has no cooldown.

uses.description: How often the ability can be used per mission; `null` when there's no limit.

effects.description: The statistics the ability changes; empty for an ability whose effect the game hardcodes, e.g. Multi-Target or Sensor Lock.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The definition's id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction).

ActivationTiming.description: When an ability takes effect, e.g. always or on command.

StatisticChange.description: A change an ability or a component makes to a statistic of the unit, its pilot or its components.

statistic.description: The statistic's name, as the game names it.

operation.description: How value changes the statistic, e.g. `Set`, `Int_Add`.

value.description: A boolean, integer or number, as the statistic's type requires. Changes to the initiative statistics (`BaseInitiative`, `PhaseModifier`, `PhaseModifierSelf`) are as the HUD numbers phases, so a positive change makes the unit act earlier.

appliesTo.description: The pilot or the components whose statistic changes; `null` when it's the unit's own.

duration.description: How long the change lasts; `null` when it lasts for the whole mission.

target.description: Whose statistic changes: the unit with the ability or component (`Creator`), the unit it targets (`SingleTarget`) or a group around it; always one the game acts on, where its data leaves it unset.

trigger.description: When the change is made, e.g. on the ability's activation, on a hit or always (`Passive`).

StatOperation.description: How a statistic change applies its value to the statistic.

EffectTargetCollection.description: The pilot or the components of the unit whose statistic a change applies to.

collection.description: The pilot, the weapons, the ammunition boxes, one random working weapon or the strongest working weapon.

filter.description: Which of the weapons or ammunition boxes; `null` when it's all of them, and always for the pilot, the random and the strongest weapon.

TargetCollection.description: Which of a unit's parts a statistic change applies to: its pilot or a group of its components.

ComponentFilter.description: The one property the game filters the components by; the game's data can name several, of which only the first in ComponentFilterKind's order counts. Each kind has a shape with its value's type.

ComponentFilterKind.description: The property of a component an effect's filter compares, in the order the game checks them.

AmmoCategoryFilter.description: A filter on the ammunition boxes' category.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The ammunition category the ammunition boxes must have, as the catalog's ammunition boxes name theirs.

WeaponCategoryFilter.description: A filter on the weapons' category.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The weapon category the weapons must have, as the catalog's weapons name theirs.

WeaponSubTypeFilter.description: A filter on the weapons' sub type.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The weapon sub type the weapons must have, e.g. `Melee` or `DFA`.

WeaponSubType.description: A weapon's sub type, e.g. a weapon model or a melee attack.

WeaponTypeFilter.description: A filter on the weapons' type.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The weapon type the weapons must have, e.g. `LRM` or `SRM`.

WeaponType.description: A weapon's type, e.g. a weapon family or melee.

EffectDuration.description: How long a statistic change lasts.

count.description: How many activations, rounds, movements or phases, by its unit, the change lasts; at least 1.

EffectDurationUnit.description: What an effect's duration counts, as `Effect` picks its `ETimer`. `activations`: The activations of the unit that made the effect. `targetActivations`: The activations of the unit the effect is on.

EffectTargetType.description: Whose statistic a change applies to, relative to the unit with the ability or component.

EffectTriggerType.description: When the game makes a statistic change.

description.description: What the skill controls, as the barracks explains it.

levels.description: The levels a pilot can train to; every pilot starts at level 1.

PilotingLevel.description: A level of the Piloting skill.

experienceCost.description: The experience spent to reach the level from the one below.

abilities.description: The primary abilities and passive traits unlocked at the level.

baseMeleeHitChancePercent.description: The hit chance of melee attacks at this level, before the attack's modifiers.

movementAfterStandingUpPercent.description: The share of its walk, sprint and backward distance a mech keeps in the round it stands up.

description.description: What the skill controls, as the barracks explains it.

levels.description: The levels a pilot can train to; every pilot starts at level 1.

SkillLevel.description: A level of a skill; a skill with numbers of its own per level adds them in its shape.

experienceCost.description: The experience spent to reach the level from the one below.

abilities.description: The primary abilities and passive traits unlocked at the level.

SpiritsLevelCosts.description: The combat effect of a pilot's spirits: the resolve their mech's Precision Strike and Vigilance cost.

precisionStrikeCost.description: The resolve a Precision Strike costs.

level.description: The pilot's spirits level the costs apply at.

SpiritsLevel.description: A pilot's spirits: normal, or temporarily high or low from an event.

ContractTypeDescription.description: A mission type with the game's description of its objectives, referred to by game-state.json activeContract.type, mission-outcome.json contract.type and game-state.json contracts[].type.

type.description: The mission type; the id `Priority` stands for every priority mission.

description.description: The game's description of the type's objectives, as plain text.

payMultiplier.description: Multiplies the pay of the type's contracts (see ContractRules); `null` when the type is `Priority`, whose pay the story sets.

JumpDistance.description: How far a mech jumps with a number of working jump jets.

jumpJets.description: The number of working jump jets, from 1; more than the last entry jump as far as it.

distance.description: The distance in meters, before it is multiplied by 1 plus the jump jets' `JumpDistanceMultiplier` effects.

CombatRules.description: The combat rules: the constants behind to-hit, evasion, cover, damage, heat, stability, melee, hit locations, visibility, resolve and movement. A to-hit modifier is added to the attack's difficulty: positive makes the attack harder, negative is a bonus.

toHit.description: How an attack's hit chance follows from its modifiers.

evasion.description: The evasion pips units earn by moving.

lineOfFire.description: How cover between attacker and target affects ranged attacks.

damage.description: The damage multipliers that apply regardless of the target.

weaponCategories.description: By the weapon category's name, as the catalog's weapons name theirs; `Melee` is the melee and jump attacks'. `AMS` is a category no exported weapon has.

strayShots.description: What a missed shot can hit instead; `null` when misses hit nothing.

coil.description: How COIL weapons gain from the attacker's evasion pips.

melee.description: The melee rules, jump attacks included.

criticalHits.description: The chance of critical hits on a mech's components.

hitTables.description: Which location a hit lands on.

ToHitRules.description: How an attack's hit chance follows from its difficulty: the base chance of the skill level (see GunneryLevel.baseHitChancePercent) loses difficultySteps per point of the summed modifiers, is rounded to roundedToPercent and clamped between minChancePercent and maxChancePercent. The modifiers below are to-hit modifiers, added to that difficulty.

difficultySteps.description: The chance lost per point of difficulty, by step from the lowest difficulty up.

roundedToPercent.description: The hit chance is rounded to the nearest multiple of this, in percent.

minChancePercent.description: The lowest hit chance, in percent.

maxChancePercent.description: The highest hit chance, in percent.

canTotalModifierBeNegative.description: Whether bonuses can push the chance above the base chance; when not, they only cancel penalties.

rangeBands.description: The modifier of each range band of the weapon.

targetWeightClass.description: The modifier for the target's size.

elevation.description: The modifier for the height difference between attacker and target.

targetShutdown.description: The modifier of ranged attacks against a shut-down mech.

targetProne.description: The modifier of ranged attacks against a prone mech.

attackerSprinted.description: The modifier when the attacker sprinted this round.

attackerWalked.description: The modifier when the attacker moved more than 10 meters this round without sprinting.

attackerStoodUp.description: The modifier when the attacker stood up this round.

attackerOverheated.description: The modifier when the attacking mech is overheated.

armMountedWeapon.description: The modifier for a mech's ranged weapon mounted in an arm.

attackerDamage.description: The modifiers for damage to the attacker's weapon or the location it's mounted in.

precisionStrike.description: The modifier of an attack made with Precision Strike.

mechFiringArcDegrees.description: How far to either side of its facing a mech can fire without turning; a turret's arc is in the catalog.

turretGunnery.description: The gunnery every turret shoots with; turrets have no pilot.

DifficultyStep.description: The hit chance lost per point of difficulty from fromDifficulty up to the next step.

fromDifficulty.description: The summed modifiers, rounded to a whole number, from which the step applies.

chanceLostPerPoint.description: As a fraction from 0 to 1, e.g. 0.05 for 5 percentage points.

RangeBandModifiers.description: The modifier by the target's distance against the weapon's ranges in the catalog.

withinMinimumRange.description: Closer than the weapon's minimum range.

short.description: From the minimum range up to the short range.

medium.description: Beyond the short range, up to the medium range.

long.description: Beyond the medium range, up to the long range.

maximum.description: Beyond the long range, up to the maximum range.

TargetWeightClassModifiers.description: The modifier for the target's size, by its kind and weight class.

mech.description: Against a mech, by its weight class.

vehicle.description: Against a vehicle, by its weight class.

turret.description: Against a turret, by its chassis' weight class.

ByWeightClassOfNumber.description: A value per weight class of the unit it applies to.

ElevationModifier.description: The modifier for the height difference: modifierPerLevel per full levelHeight the attacker stands below the target, a bonus of as much per level above it.

modifierPerLevel.description: The modifier per level of height difference.

usesMultipleLevels.description: Whether more than one level counts.

appliesPenalties.description: Whether an attacker below the target is penalized.

AttackerWalkedModifiers.description: The modifier when the attacker walked this round, by its kind.

mech.description: For an attacking mech, by its weight class.

AttackerDamageModifiers.description: The to-hit modifiers for damage to the attacker's weapon or its location, by the attacker's kind; an attacking turret gets none.

WeaponDamageModifiers.description: The to-hit modifiers for damage to the attacking weapon and its location; both apply when the weapon and its location are damaged.

damagedWeapon.description: For a weapon damaged by a critical hit but not destroyed.

weaponInDamagedLocation.description: For a weapon in a damaged location.

DamagedLocationModifiers.description: The modifier for a weapon in a damaged location, by the location's damage.

nonFunctional.description: The location is damaged beyond use.

EvasionRules.description: How a unit earns evasion pips by moving and what each pip does to ranged attacks against it. A sensor lock strips pips (see SensorLockRules.evasivePipsStripped).

pipsByDistanceMoved.description: The pips for moving more than a distance; a jump adds one, also in place, and the unit's own maximum caps them. A mech moving more than 12 m then gets its `EvasivePipsGainedAdditional` statistic on top, past the cap.

modifierByPips.description: The to-hit modifier by the number of pips the weapon doesn't ignore, from one pip up; for more pips than entries, the pips times the difference of the last two.

weaponTypesAffected.description: The weapon types the pips apply to, by the game's names, where the weapon's category is affected too (WeaponCategoryRules.isAffectedByEvasion).

pipsStrippedPerAttack.description: The pips every unit an attack affects loses when the attack ends, hit or miss: the target and any unit a missed shot hits.

vehiclePipMultiplier.description: A vehicle's pips are multiplied by this and rounded down.

canVehiclesBeEvasive.description: Whether vehicles get evasion pips at all.

EvasivePips.description: The evasion pips a move longer than a distance earns.

moreThan.description: The distance in meters the unit has to exceed.

pips.description: The pips the unit gets for it.

GuardRules.description: How guard levels reduce damage: bracing, Bulwark and cover from terrain each add a level. Attacks from behind, melee and breaching shots ignore them. They don't reduce stability damage.

damageMultiplierByLevel.description: Indexed by the guard level, from unguarded up.

unsteadyBreaksGuard.description: Whether an unsteady unit loses the levels from bracing and Bulwark; cover still counts.

solidDamageBreaksGuard.description: Whether a mech hit without guard since its last activation loses the levels from bracing and Bulwark.

sensorLockBreaksGuard.description: Whether a sensor-locked unit loses the levels from bracing and Bulwark.

canVehiclesBeGuarded.description: Whether vehicles get every guard level; when not, they get one at most.

LineOfFireRules.description: The line of fire by the share of clear sight lines between attacker and target: clear at clearRatio or more, obstructed at obstructedRatio or more, blocked below.

obstructedToHit.description: The to-hit modifier of an obstructed line of fire; not against a building.

obstructedDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplies the damage through an obstructed line of fire; not against a building.

indirectFireToHit.description: The to-hit modifier of indirect fire, at a blocked line of fire.

indirectFireDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplies the damage of indirect fire; not against a building.

clearRatio.description: The share of clear sight lines for a clear line of fire, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

obstructedRatio.description: The share of clear sight lines for an obstructed line of fire, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

minRatioFromUnits.description: Units in the way alone can't lower the share below this.

DamageRules.description: The damage multipliers that apply regardless of the target. A building takes none of the cover, terrain and damage reduction multipliers, which apply only to units.

globalMultiplier.description: Multiplies the damage and structure damage of every weapon, melee and jump attacks and mortars included; not of artillery strikes.

artilleryAgainstBuildingsMultiplier.description: Multiplies the damage artillery strikes and mortars deal to a building.

WeaponCategoryRules.description: What a weapon category's attacks do against units of each kind.

vehicleDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplies the damage and structure damage the category's hits deal to a vehicle.

turretDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplies the damage and structure damage the category's hits deal to a turret.

isAffectedByEvasion.description: Whether the target's evasion pips apply to the category's attacks; the weapon's type must also be one of EvasionRules.weaponTypesAffected.

StrayShotRules.description: A missed ranged shot hits the first building in its path within the weapon's maximum range instead, or a unit where unitsHit allows; never the attacker, and the target only when it's a building.

unitsHit.description: Which units a missed shot can hit, from the attacker's side: `ENEMIES_ONLY`, `ENEMIES_AND_NEUTRAL` or `EVERYONE`; `null` when it hits only buildings.

StrayShotValidTargets.description: Which units a missed shot can hit instead.

CoilRules.description: How a COIL weapon gains from its mech's evasion pips; the weapon's own values are its catalog.json componentDefinitions.weapons.*.coil.

multipliesShots.description: Whether the pips multiply the shots fired, never below the base; when not, once the mech has moved this round and not sprinted, the damage of one shot is multiplied by the pips to the power of catalog.json componentDefinitions.weapons.*.coil.evasiveExponent, never below the base damage.

countsJumps.description: Whether the pips count after a jump; when not, a jump leaves the weapon at its base.

HeatRules.description: The heat rules of mechs; vehicles and turrets have no heat. What Coolant Vent does is with the ability in SkillRules.

maxHeat.description: The heat at which a mech shuts down.

overheatsAbove.description: Above this heat the mech is overheated: it takes overheatStructureDamageByWeightClass in every location but the head whenever its heat is reconciled, and its attacks and movement are penalized.

walkHeat.description: The heat a mech gains from a move other than a sprint or a jump.

sprintHeat.description: The heat a mech gains from a sprint.

jumpHeat.description: The heat a mech gains from a jump.

engineDamageHeat.description: The heat a mech gains at the end of each activation while its center torso is damaged beyond use.

engineHeatSinks.description: The heat sinks every mech has built in, on top of the chassis' dissipation.

engineHeatSinkDissipation.description: The heat each of the engineHeatSinks dissipates.

maxHeatAfterRestart.description: A mech restarting from shutdown is cooled to at most this heat.

heatGeneratedMultiplier.description: Multiplies all heat a mech generates itself.

heatSinkMultiplier.description: Multiplies a mech's heat sink capacity, together with the terrain's and biome's.

overheatStructureDamageByWeightClass.description: The structure damage per location an overheated mech takes, by its weight class.

JumpHeat.description: A jump's heat: perUnit for each started unitSize meters of the distance, at least minimum.

perUnit.description: The heat per unit of distance.

minimum.description: The least heat a jump generates.

StabilityRules.description: The stability rules of mechs. A mech's stability bar is divided into equal levels; a mech that reaches unsteadyAbovePercent of its stability is unsteady and loses its evasion pips, and an unsteady mech that fills the bar is knocked down.

unsteadyAbovePercent.description: In percent of the stability bar; a mech's `UnsteadyThreshold` statistic starts at it, and combat-state.json units.*.state.mech.stability.unsteadyAbove is its current value in points.

levels.description: The number of equal levels the stability bar is divided into.

levelsRecovered.description: The levels of instability an action removes, after the level the mech is in is always emptied.

levelsAdded.description: The levels of instability an action adds to the mech doing it, after the level the mech is in is emptied.

entrenchedInstabilityMultiplier.description: Multiplies the instability a braced mech takes from weapons.

minStabilityPerDestroyedLocation.description: The share of the stability bar a mech can't recover below for each destroyed location.

onlyLegsRaiseMinStability.description: Whether only destroyed legs count for it.

instabilityFromDamage.description: The share of the stability bar added when a location is damaged, on top of a weapon's own stability damage.

LevelsRecoveredByAction.description: The levels of instability a mech's action this round removes.

stationary.description: When the mech moved less than a meter this round, or not at all.

walked.description: When the mech moved without sprinting or jumping; a sprint recovers nothing.

deferred.description: When the mech's pilot has the ability that resets instability on deferring.

LevelsAddedByAction.description: The levels of instability an action adds to the mech doing it.

deathFromAbove.description: When the mech's own jump attack makes it unsteady.

falling.description: When the building the mech stands on is destroyed and it falls.

InstabilityFromDamage.description: The share of the stability bar added when a location is damaged, by the location and damage.

sideTorsoDestroyed.description: Added when a side torso is destroyed.

centerTorsoDamaged.description: Added when the center torso's damage reaches each of its two damage levels.

armDestroyed.description: Added when an arm is destroyed.

legDamaged.description: Added on any leg damage; a destroyed leg fills the bar instead.

InjuryRules.description: What injures a mech's pilot, besides head hits and knockdowns.

fromSideTorsoDestruction.description: Whether the destruction of a side torso injures the pilot.

fromAmmoExplosion.description: Whether an exploding ammunition box or other component injures the pilot.

fromHeatShutdown.description: Whether shutting down from heat injures the pilot.

MeleeAttackRules.description: The melee rules; damage and stability damage are the chassis' in the catalog. A melee attack against a turret, a building, a prone or a shut-down mech always has the maximum hit chance. The damage against vehicles and turrets is multiplied by the `Melee` weapon category's (see CombatRules.weaponCategories).

deathFromAboveToHit.description: The to-hit modifier of a jump attack.

maxHeightDifference.description: The largest height difference, in meters, between the attacker's position and the target's for a melee or jump attack.

CriticalHitRules.description: Critical hits on a mech's components, rolled when a shot damages a location's structure: the chance is the location's share of lost structure, at least minChance, times the weapon's multiplier.

aiAttackerMultiplier.description: Multiplies the chance when the attacker isn't player-controlled.

emptySlotsAbsorbCrits.description: Whether a critical hit on an empty or destroyed slot does nothing.

HitTables.description: Which location a hit lands on: relative weights per location by the direction the attack comes from, in the target's four quadrants, or against a prone mech from any side.

mech.description: The weights of a mech's armor locations.

vehicle.description: The weights of a vehicle's locations.

calledShot.description: How a called shot raises the chosen location's weight.

clusteredHits.description: Multiplies the weights for the later hits of a weapon that fires several, by their place relative to the first hit.

MechHitTables.description: A mech's hit tables, which a vehicle's lack: a mech can be prone.

fromFront.description: The weight of each location for an attack from the front.

fromLeft.description: The weight of each location for an attack from the left.

fromRight.description: The weight of each location for an attack from the right.

fromBack.description: The weight of each location for an attack from behind.

artillery.description: The locations an artillery strike or mortar hits, all at once; each takes the full damage, which a mortar rolls anew per location.

prone.description: The weight of each location for an attack on a prone mech, from any side.

ArmorLocation.description: A mech's armor location, the torso's front and rear apart.

HitTablesOfVehicleChassisLocations.description: The hit tables of a kind of unit, by the direction the attack comes from.

fromFront.description: The weight of each location for an attack from the front.

fromLeft.description: The weight of each location for an attack from the left.

fromRight.description: The weight of each location for an attack from the right.

fromBack.description: The weight of each location for an attack from behind.

artillery.description: The locations an artillery strike or mortar hits, all at once; each takes the full damage, which a mortar rolls anew per location.

CalledShotRules.description: A called shot multiplies the chosen location's weight by weightMultiplier times the pilot's own multiplier; after every hit of the attack the multiplier moves towards 1 by degradePerHit of the way.

weightMultiplier.description: Multiplies the chosen location's weight, before the pilot's own multiplier.

degradePerHit.description: The share of the way to 1 the multiplier moves after each hit, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

ClusteredHitWeights.description: The multipliers of the location weights for the later hits of a weapon that fires several.

sameLocation.description: For the location the first hit landed on.

adjacentLocation.description: For the locations adjacent to the first hit's.

isHeadMultiplied.description: Whether the head's weight is multiplied like the other locations'.

canHeadBeClustered.description: Whether a later hit can land on the head after a first hit elsewhere; after one on the head, it always can.

VisibilityRules.description: Spotting and sensors. A unit is seen within the spotter range with a line of sight, and shows as a sensor blip within the sensor range; both are multiplied by the chassis' values, and the sensor range by the target's signature. The blip's detail depends on the spotter's Tactics: 4 shows the unit's type, 7 its details.

spotterRangePerTactics.description: Added to the spotter range per point of Tactics.

sensorHysteresis.description: Added to the sensor range against a target already detected.

shutdownSpotterMultiplier.description: A shut-down unit's spotter range, as a share of the base range alone.

proneSpotterMultiplier.description: A prone mech's spotter range, as a share of the base range alone.

shutdownSignatureModifier.description: Added to a shut-down unit's signature.

shutdownVisibilityModifier.description: Added to a shut-down unit's visibility multiplier.

ghostedUnitsHideBlips.description: Whether a unit in stealth hides from sensors altogether.

sensorLock.description: What a sensor lock does to its target.

firedWeaponsEffects.description: The statistic changes a unit makes to itself when it fires.

SensorLockRules.description: What a sensor lock does to its target, besides making it visible to the whole lance.

evasivePipsStripped.description: The evasion pips the target loses; 0 when a sensor lock strips none.

targetEffects.description: The statistic changes the target gets, one entry per application of a change the game applies repeatedly. The change of -999 to `GhostEffectStacks` removes all of the target's stealth pips from ECM, however many it has: the game counts them only above 0.

ResolveRules.description: The lance's resolve in combat, which Precision Strike and Vigilance spend (see SpiritsLevelCosts).

min.description: The lowest resolve the lance can have.

max.description: The highest resolve the lance can have.

startsAt.description: The resolve at the start of a mission, unless the contract sets its own.

inspiredAt.description: At this resolve the lance's mechs get inspiredEffects.

inspireCost.description: The resolve each mech spends when inspired.

isAutoInspired.description: Whether the whole lance is inspired as soon as the resolve allows, and loses it below.

inspiredEffects.description: The statistic changes an inspired mech gets.

baselineGainPerRound.description: Gained every round from the second, times the units baselineGainScalesWith counts.

baselineGainScalesWith.description: What baselineGainPerRound is multiplied by the count of.

addsMoraleLevelResolve.description: Whether the company's morale level adds its resolve per round (see MoraleLevel.resolvePerRound).

addsUnitResolveBonuses.description: Whether the units' resolve bonuses add to the gain, the `MoraleBonusGain` statistic that cockpit mods change.

onlyBiggestUnitResolveBonus.description: Whether only the biggest unit bonus counts instead of their sum.

eventThresholds.description: The shares of shots and armor at which an attack's events happen.

fromEvents.description: The resolve gained from what the lance's attacks do and from objectives.

initiativeDelayEffects.description: What a Precision Strike or a knockdown does to the target, on top of the stability damage.

canAiGainResolve.description: Whether the enemy gains resolve at all.

ResolveGainScale.description: What the baseline gain is multiplied by the count of.

ResolveEventThresholds.description: The shares at which an attack's resolve events happen, as fractions from 0 to 1.

majorityHit.description: The share of an attack's shots that have to hit for the majority-hit event.

majorityMiss.description: The share of shots below which the majority-miss event happens.

minorArmorDamage.description: The share of the target's starting armor an attack has to take off.

majorArmorDamage.description: The share above which the damage counts as major instead.

ResolveFromEvents.description: The resolve the lance gains from what its attacks do to enemies, each once per attack except kills and major armor damage, which count per enemy, and from failed objectives.

enemyDestroyed.description: By the enemy's weight class; a turret counts as light.

enemyDestroyedInMelee.description: Added to enemyDestroyed for a melee kill.

enemyCriticalHit.description: For a critical hit on an enemy.

enemyAmmoExplosion.description: For an exploding ammunition box or other component of an enemy.

enemyWeaponDestroyed.description: For a destroyed weapon of an enemy.

enemyLocationDestroyed.description: For a destroyed location of an enemy.

deathFromAboveDealt.description: For a death from above attack that damages its target.

enemyMinorArmorDamage.description: For taking off more than ResolveEventThresholds.minorArmorDamage of an enemy's armor.

enemyMajorArmorDamage.description: For taking off more than ResolveEventThresholds.majorArmorDamage of an enemy's armor, instead of enemyMinorArmorDamage; counted for every enemy the attack damages so.

majorityHit.description: For an attack of which more than ResolveEventThresholds.majorityHit of the shots hit.

majorityMiss.description: For an attack of which less than ResolveEventThresholds.majorityMiss of the shots hit, when the attack changes the lance's resolve in no other way.

objectiveCompleted.description: For a secondary objective; primary ones count nothing.

objectiveFailed.description: For a failed secondary objective; primary ones count nothing.

ByWeightClassOfInteger.description: A value per weight class of the unit it applies to.

MovementRules.description: What shortens a mech's walk, sprint and backward distance; the penalties add up and the distance keeps at least minMultiplier. Jump distance is unaffected (see jumpDistances).

legDamagePenalty.description: The share lost per leg, by its damage.

minMultiplier.description: The least share of the distance a mech keeps, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

pivotInPlaceThreshold.description: A move that ends closer than this to where it started, in meters, only turns the mech and costs no move.

hexWidth.description: The width of the movement grid's hexes in meters.

LegDamagePenalties.description: The share of the distance a mech loses per leg, by the leg's damage.

nonFunctional.description: The leg is damaged beyond use but not destroyed.

CampaignRules.description: The campaign rules: the constants behind the mech lab, the med bay, hiring, salvage, finances, contracts, alliances and travel, as the game uses them with the career's difficulty settings.

mechLab.description: What mech lab work costs and how long it takes.

medBay.description: How long pilots take to heal and how likely an incapacitated pilot dies.

hiring.description: Hiring and paying pilots, and the roster and mech bay sizes the ship's pods allow.

salvage.description: How a mission's salvage is made.

finances.description: The financial reports and their expenses, jump costs, store and scrap shares, debt limit and morale changes.

contracts.description: How contracts are generated, paid and rewarded.

alliances.description: Allying with factions and breaking alliances.

travel.description: How long a trip takes and how far a jump reaches.

MechLabRules.description: What mech lab work costs. The mech lab works through its orders one at a time, paying the company's game-state.json company.mechTech tech points a day, so an order takes its tech points divided by that, rounded up, at least a day.

destroyedLocationRepairMultipliers.description: Multiply structureRepair for a location that was destroyed.

componentRepair.description: Per slot of the component; a chassis' fixed components are repaired for free.

install.description: Per slot of the component, by its category.

armorChange.description: Per point of armor added or removed.

uninstallTechPointsPerSlot.description: Removing a component takes these instead of its category's install tech points; its C-Bills are still the category's, none for a destroyed component.

cancelRefundShare.description: The share of the unpaid work refunded when a started order is cancelled.

MechLabCost.description: What a kind of mech lab work costs.

techPoints.description: The tech points the work takes, per the unit its use names.

cBills.description: The C-Bills the work costs, per the same unit.

MechLabCostMultipliers.description: Multipliers of a mech lab cost.

InstallCosts.description: By the component's category, weapons by their type.

ballistic.description: For autocannons, Gauss rifles and machine guns.

MedBayRules.description: How long healing takes: a pilot's injuries cost heal points, and the med bay pays healPointsBase plus healPointsPerMedTech times the company's game-state.json company.medTech a day to each injured pilot.

healPointsBase.description: The heal points each injured pilot gets a day, whatever the med tech.

healPointsPerMedTech.description: The heal points added per point of game-state.json company.medTech.

injuryCost.description: Divided by the pilot's health for each injury, rounded down.

lethalInjuryCost.description: Added once for a pilot who took lethal injuries and survived.

incapacitatedCost.description: Added once for a pilot who was incapacitated.

deathChance.description: The chance that an incapacitated pilot dies after the mission.

PilotDeathChance.description: The chance that an incapacitated pilot dies after the mission: incapacitated, or lethal after lethal injuries, less reductionPerGuts per point of Guts.

incapacitated.description: Without lethal injuries, as a fraction from 0 to 1; 1 or more is certain before Guts.

lethal.description: After lethal injuries, as a fraction from 0 to 1; 1 or more is certain before Guts.

reductionPerGuts.description: As a fraction from 0 to 1; the chance doesn't fall below 0.

HiringRules.description: Hiring and paying pilots. A pilot's skill total is the sum of their four skills; their base skills are the ones they were hired with, the bonus skills the ones trained since.

costPerBaseSkillPoint.description: The hiring price, before the adjustment for the reputation with the star system's owner.

pilotsPerSystem.description: How many pilots a star system's hiring hall offers.

roninChance.description: The chance of each of them being a ronin, unless the star system sets its own.

generatedPilotHealth.description: The health, the injuries they can take, of the pilots the game generates.

moraleLimits.description: Low company morale limits who can be hired.

maxPilotsPerBarracksPod.description: The roster size each barracks pod of the ship allows.

maxMechsPerMechBayPod.description: The mech bays each mech bay pod of the ship allows.

MoraleHiringLimit.description: Below a company morale, only pilots up to a skill total can be hired; the first matching limit applies.

belowMorale.description: The company morale below which the limit applies.

maxHireableSkillTotal.description: The highest skill total of a pilot the company can hire under the limit.

SalvageRules.description: How a mission's salvage is made. The picks are the contract's salvage potential times the negotiated share plus floorBonus, times the outcome's chance less its loss per mech the company lost; the priority picks are priorityShare of them, at most maxPriorityPicks. The rest is drawn from the pool by pickWeights. A destroyed enemy mech yields its parts by how it died: 1 for a destroyed center torso, 2 for both legs, 3 for the head or an incapacitated pilot.

defaultPotential.description: The salvage potential of a contract that sets none.

retreat.description: For a mission the company retreated from.

priorityShare.description: The share of the picks that are priority picks, as a fraction from 0 to 1, rounded down.

maxPriorityPicks.description: The most priority picks a mission gives, hardcoded by the game.

floorBonus.description: Picks added to the negotiated share of a contract's salvage potential, unless the potential is 0.

pickWeights.description: The relative weights the picks are drawn from the pool by.

rareSwaps.description: The chance of a salvaged component being swapped for a rarer one.

culledComponentRarity.description: Components of this rarity or above never come as salvage.

destroyedMechRecoveryChance.description: The chance of getting back a lost mech whose center torso was destroyed; a mech with its center torso intact always comes back.

assembledMechsComeEquipped.description: Whether a mech assembled from parts or bought comes with its stock loadout instead of only its fixed components.

SalvageOutcome.description: What a mission's outcome does to its salvage.

chance.description: Multiplies the picks, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

chanceLostPerMechDestroyed.description: Taken off chance for each of the company's mechs destroyed or whose pilot was incapacitated, down to 0.

SalvagePickWeights.description: The relative weights the salvage drawn at random is drawn from the pool by, per kind of item.

component.description: The weight of any other component.

mechPart.description: The weight of a mech part.

RareSalvageSwaps.description: The chance of a salvaged component being swapped for a rarer one, by kind of component.

weapons.description: For weapons, which keep their kind.

RareSalvageSwap.description: The chance of a swap is the contract's difficulty plus the tier's `chanceOffset`, divided by divisor; the very rare tier is rolled first.

veryRare.description: The very rare tier, rolled first.

rare.description: The rare tier, compared with the same roll, so it applies when the roll is below its chance but not the very rare tier's.

divisor.description: Divides the contract's difficulty plus a tier's offset, giving the tier's chance as a fraction from 0 to 1.

RareSalvageTier.description: A tier of rarer components a salvaged component can be swapped for.

rarities.description: The rarities the swapped-in component is drawn from.

chanceOffset.description: Added to the contract's difficulty before RareSalvageSwap.divisor.

FinancesRules.description: The company's expenses, trade and debt, and the morale effects of failed missions.

daysPerReport.description: The days between financial reports, which deduct the expenses.

mechCostPerReport.description: The upkeep of each mech in a mech bay.

shipMaintenance.description: The ship's own maintenance in each report's expenses.

spendingLevels.description: The spending levels, which game-state.json financialReport.spending.level refers to.

jumpCost.description: The C-Bills each jump of a trip costs.

sellShare.description: The share of its value a store pays for a stored chassis or an undamaged component, rounded down. Every store pays the same: the reputation price change applies to purchases only. Mech parts and the mechs in the mech bay can't be sold, only scrapped.

sellDamagedShare.description: The share of its value a store pays for a damaged component, rounded down.

scrapShare.description: The share of the chassis' value scrapping a mech or chassis pays, rounded to the nearest C-Bill; mech parts pay it times their share of the parts needed. Scrapping a component pays this share of its value, rounded down.

maxDebt.description: The company is dissolved when its funds fall below this.

badFaithMoraleChange.description: When a mission is failed without a good faith effort.

catastropheMoraleChange.description: When every pilot sent on a mission is killed.

ShipMaintenance.description: The ship's own line in the expenses of each report, before the spending level's multiplier.

leopard.description: The C-Bills while the company's ship is the Leopard.

argo.description: The C-Bills while the company's ship is the Argo.

level.description: The spending level, as the game names it, e.g. `Spartan`.

costMultiplier.description: Multiplies the expenses of each report.

moraleChange.description: Applied once when the level is confirmed at a report.

EconomyScale.description: A spending level, from the cheapest to the most generous.

ContractRules.description: How contracts are generated, paid and rewarded. A contract's pay is payPerDifficulty times the mission type's ContractTypeDescription.payMultiplier times a scale of its difficulty (the sum of 1 / (0.4 n) for n from 1 to the difficulty, less 1.5), varied by up to payVariance either way and rounded to thousands. The reputation payment adjustments the reputation tooltips show aren't exported: the pay never applies them.

payPerDifficulty.description: In C-Bills, before the type's multiplier, the difficulty scale and the variance.

payVariance.description: The most the pay varies either way, as a fraction from 0 to 1 of the pay.

guaranteedPayShare.description: The share of the pay the company gets on top of the negotiated share.

goodFaithPayShare.description: The share of the pay for a mission not completed, with a good faith effort.

noFaithPayShare.description: The share without a good faith effort.

experience.description: The experience a contract's pilots earn.

maxGlobalDifficulty.description: The career's global difficulty never exceeds this.

difficultyVariance.description: A contract's difficulty is the star system's plus the global one, varied by up to this either way.

maxPerSystem.description: The most contracts a star system offers at once, unless it sets its own.

renewedPerRefresh.description: Added to a star system's open contract slots at each renewal.

refreshDays.description: A star system's open contract slots are renewed once more than this many days passed since their last renewal, so every refreshDays + 1 days.

removedPerCompleted.description: Taken off a star system's open contract slots for each contract completed there.

ContractReputationRules.description: The reputation a contract changes: the employer gains the base plus the negotiated share of the negotiable value, the target loses the employer's gain times its multiplier, and the Mercenary Review Board rating gains the difficulty times the rating level's multiplier (see MercenaryReviewBoardLevel).

basePerDifficulty.description: Times the contract's difficulty before the skulls' adjustment, rounded before baseAddition is added.

baseAddition.description: Added to basePerDifficulty times the difficulty, rounded.

negotiablePerDifficulty.description: Times the contract's difficulty before the skulls' adjustment, rounded before negotiableAddition is added.

negotiableAddition.description: Added to negotiablePerDifficulty times the difficulty, rounded.

target.description: Multiplies the employer's gain, before employer, into the target's change; negative for a loss.

mercenaryReviewBoard.description: Multiplies the Mercenary Review Board rating gained.

OutcomeMultipliers.description: What the mission's outcome does to a reward.

goodFaith.description: Not completed, with a good faith effort.

ContractExperienceRules.description: The experience every pilot sent on the mission earns.

perDifficulty.description: Times the contract's difficulty, rounded down.

failed.description: Multiplies it for a failed mission.

retreatedGoodFaith.description: Multiplies it for a retreat with a good faith effort.

retreatedBadFaith.description: Multiplies it for a retreat without one.

AllianceRules.description: What allying with a faction takes and what breaking the alliance costs.

reputationNeeded.description: The faction reputation an alliance needs.

reputationAfterBreaking.description: The faction reputation after breaking the alliance.

cooldownDays.description: The days before a broken alliance can be renewed.

TravelRules.description: How long a trip takes, as each star-systems.json starSystems.*.route states it: each jump's days plus the days to and from the jump point at both ends, scaled by the Argo's drive upgrades.

daysPerJump.description: Of a jump from a star system without a fuel station.

daysPerJumpFromFuelStation.description: Of a jump from a star system with one.

defaultDaysToJumpPoint.description: For a star system that sets no distance of its own.

maxJumpDistance.description: The farthest a jump reaches on the starmap, in light years.
